title: Oracle shadow simulation over a run
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $S$ a state type, $x$ a Boolean input word, $i$ one of $n$ tape indices, $A$ a machine on $n$ Boolean tapes, $c$ a configuration, and $b$ a Boolean tag. If the head position on tape $i$ lies on the side of the origin indicated by $b$—nonnegative when $b$ is true and nonpositive when it is false—then for every number of steps $t$ there is a tag $b'$ such that the head position on tape $i$ after running $A$ for $t$ steps lies on the side indicated by $b'$, and running the augmented shadow machine for $t$ steps from the augmented configuration equals the augmentation of the original run with tag $b'$.
hypotheses_covered: initial head position lies on the side indicated by $b$
